death.note: No explicit death date; al-Sakhāwī infers he died after the year 800 H (the date of the ijāza), which is why he recorded him.

relation.note: al-Ṭāwusī (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī al-Futūḥ, AIND-D03720) read to the subject in Shiraz introductory works in grammar and morphology — al-Kāfiya of al-Zanjānī and its commentaries by al-Sayyid Rukn al-Dīn and al-Taftāzānī — and the subject granted him an ijāza in the months of the year 800 H.

person.note: アフマド・アル＝ファフル・アッ＝シーファスキー・アッ＝シーラーズィー。アッ＝タウースィー（＝AIND-D03720）は語る。私はシーラーズで彼のもとで、諸学の入門書――ザンジャーニーの『カーフィヤ』（文法学・形態論）およびサイイド・ルクン・アッ＝ディーンとタフターザーニーによるその二つの注釈書など――を朗読した。そして彼は800年のうちに私にイジャーザを与えた。彼はその後に亡くなったと思われ、それゆえ私は彼を記した。

Aḥmad al-Fakhr al-Shīfaskī al-Shīrāzī. Al-Ṭāwusī (= AIND-D03720) said: I read to him in Shiraz the introductions to the sciences — such as al-Kāfiya in grammar and morphology by al-Zanjānī and its two commentaries by al-Sayyid Rukn al-Dīn and al-Taftāzānī, and others — and he granted me an ijāza in the months of the year 800 H. It appears he died after that, and that is why I recorded him.
